caption: The drawing features a rectangular composition predominantly filled with text and several circular vignettes around the border. The entire illustration is rendered in reddish-brown ink on a light background. At the center is a titled “Numeration Table” surrounded by various arithmetic tables and conversion charts, all printed in rows and columns with numbers and words. Encircling the text, there are six large circular scenes: at the top center, children are depicted playing outside a building labeled "School"; to the upper left, two figures interact, one standing on a step; to the upper right, a person sits while another stands nearby; the bottom left shows two people, one appearing to discipline the other; the bottom right depicts an elder figure with two children standing; the middle left shows two children near a house; the middle right features two children walking away from a building. Banners with text label each illustration. The background of the entire image is crosshatched, and the edges are bordered by a thin line.
title: Cloth with Numeration Table
